questions.subject: ENGLISH_LITERATURE
questions.learningObjective: Explain how a delayed modifier changes the force of a specification
questions.stem: In a design brief, the phrase 'for a market that has not yet chosen a supplier' is placed after the noun it describes. What effect does this delay create?

answer.exemplar: The postponed modifier forces the reader to complete the noun phrase first and only then learn that the specification depends on an unresolved decision, so the uncertainty arrives as a late twist rather than as an assumed fact.

questions.explanation: Postponing the modifier makes the reader meet the caveat only after committing to the noun, so the unresolved condition lands as a qualified afterthought instead of a stated fact.
questions.hint: Ask when the reader actually learns the qualifying clause.

options.text: Refrain, because the repeated word marks the point the writer wants to keep

questions.explanation: The word 'tolerance' returns at the same emphatic position each time, marking the point the writer wants kept. That is the working of a refrain.
questions.hint: Think about the word that keeps coming back on purpose.

questions.subject: ENGLISH_LITERATURE
questions.learningObjective: Synthesise how line breaks shape a brief's closing effect
questions.stem: A brief ends with the line 'The bracket held' set alone, after a long paragraph about the failures before it. Which judgement is best supported?

options.text: The break makes the ending look like an accident of formatting rather than a choice
options.misconception: explains the ending as an accident of layout

options.text: The break reveals that the writer had not finished the argument when the brief was sent
options.misconception: infers the brief was unfinished when it was sent

options.text: The break summarises the whole brief in a single word and replaces the earlier detail
options.misconception: claims the line replaces the earlier narrative

options.text: The break isolates a flat statement so that everything the reader was told before it stays in view

questions.explanation: Setting a short flat line after a long account leaves the earlier failures hovering around it. The plainness of the line is what lets that contrast register.
questions.hint: Consider what stays in view around the final line.
